versions.changelog:
- Initial release of trading-intelligence-bundle.
- Combines momentum, whale sentiment, and regime confluence signals into a single real-time API response.
- Designed for one-call, multi-factor trading analysis using APEX Runner’s live autonomous trading system (Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, Hyperliquid).
- Accessible via x402-authenticated GET; no account, API key, or subscription needed — only an EVM wallet with USDC on Base mainnet.
- Tiered, wallet-based pricing with early adopter discount through 2026-09-21.
